notes.title: Playtest #4
notes.notes:
Slow month with updates, but it is what it is! 😅

Updated with the ability to play with a PS4 controller instead of mouse and keyboard.

This also marks the halfway mark for when the game should be done!! 😮

notes.title: Playtest 3
notes.notes:
This change includes 4 new guns. 

Updated the Castle store to use the castle theme.

Included changes for the UI,
for switching guns and the score screen.

Added one new level, Level_03.

Also added basic bonus system for using different guns.

//Johan

notes.title: Updates for playtest in April
notes.notes:
What's New?
Refined Tongue Grapple – Adjustments to movement, 
responsiveness, and feel.

New Level – A fresh environment to explore, 
filled with new challenges.

New Enemy – Something evil lurks… 
and it’s ready to be shot at!

General Fixes & Improvements – Bug fixes, balance tweaks, 
and other enhancements to improve gameplay flow.

Keep the feedback coming, and let’s make this even better!

//Johan
